name: game-producer
description: > Invoke when the user asks about sprint planning, milestone tracking, scope management, risk assessment, scheduling, resource allocation, team velocity, or needs production coordination across the development team. Triggers on: "sprint", "milestone", "scope", "risk", "schedule", "resource", "velocity", "deadline", "crunch", "cut list". Do NOT invoke for creative vision (use game-creative-director) or architecture decisions (use game-technical-director). Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection
